messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up — billing console showed a provisional balance drop below zero for acct 421 after a canary failover. looks linked to a streaming request that spawned a toolcall, reconnect, and a router fallback. :confused:
diego: Oof. Any logs or trace id?
rachel: trace ses_C4t9q — excerpt below. console snapshot: provisional +20 then reconcile -35 => net -15.
rachel: logs (sanitized):
``nrouter.DEBUG: session=ses_C4t9q route=us-east-2 -> fallback=eu-central reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_2147 attached
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (missing)
ledger.INFO: session=ses_C4t9q provisional_add=+20 toolcall=ptc_2147 truncated=true
ledger.INFO: session=ses_C4t9q confirm_add=+20 toolcall=ptc_2147 reason=incomplete-confirm
ledger.INFO: session=ses_C4t9q reconcile_adjust=-35 reason=dedupe-finalize
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+20 provisional_after=-15
```
diego: Looks like router dropped the idempotency header during the fallback; target region created a new toolcall and ledger later deduped by subtracting 35.
liam: We allow negative reconciles internally, but UI should never display negative provisional. server/API must clamp to 0 and we should emit a reconciliation event so CS can see why.
avery: Agreed. Console quick-fix: show 0 and surface a yellow banner "Billing correction applied during routing retry" with link to audit logs. will craft copy.
chao: Root cause ack: fallback router reconstructs outbound headers and we missed copying the prefetch_toolcall_id into X-Toolcall-Idempotency. I'll add conservative header forwarding in the reconnect path and unit tests for fallback.
diego: Can we also add a safety in the ledger apply path to avoid double-applying provisional on reconnect? maybe require idempotency key or session-bound dedupe.
liam: Ledger safety: we'll require an idempotency token for provisional_apply; if missing, log and tag it for manual review rather than blindly apply. For existing accounts with provisional < 0, we clamp API responses and emit metric billing.reconciles.negative_count.
sre-bot: Alert: provisional_negative_detected account=421 value=-15 canary=canary-2026-02 rate=1
rachel: Repro steps added to PLAT-4022: enable prefetch sidecar, start streaming request with X-Toolcall-Idempotency header, kill connection mid-toolcall to trigger fallback, allow router to route to alt region.
avery: ETA for UI patch: 3h to clamp + banner. will depend on ledger exposing a correction flag.
liam: I'll push a small server-side clamp and emit audit events — ETA 1.5h. will stage to canary immediately.
chao: Router patch ETA: 6h for CR, unit tests; canary tomorrow. Also adding integration test that simulates header-loss fallback so we catch regressions.
diego: SRE please run PLAT-4022 repro in staging after liam's clamp and chao's patch are in canary.
sre-bot: Repro job scheduled PLAT-4022 on staging cluster at 2026-02-14T18:00Z.
rachel: Owners: liam (ledger), chao (router), avery (console), diego (SRE reporter).
liam: Also adding telemetry tag reconcile_reason=dedupe-finalize so we can alert on frequency by canary/region.
avery: UI copy suggestion: "A provisional billing correction was applied after a routed retry; final charges are available in billing history."
chao: One more note: make fallback header copy conservative (only copy prefetch_toolcall_id when prefetch=true) to avoid leaking unrelated headers across regions.
ops-bot: Incident logged PLAT-4022 severity=low impact=customer-visible state=investigating
rachel: Thanks all. Closing slack thread; followups in PLAT-4022 and PRs. Ping me for raw traces if needed.
